caveats: YC public framework; website returns 402 DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED. No currently verified managed compute service or billable hosted rate; not inferred from the framework.

Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

usage_api.quote: Hyrex is a modern, open-source task orchestration framework. Fully Open-Source. Built on Postgres. Deploy anywhere. Self-hosted workers run on customer's own infrastructure; no managed sandbox service with billable usage tracking.
usage_api.note: granularity: none; cost: no; Self-hosted task framework without a managed service offering. Website returns 402 DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED. No usage/billing API provided by Hyrex; task state and execution tracked in customer's own Postgres database.
